babs.2: The saying of Allah the Exalted: "Surely, the curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers"
babs.3: A Muslim does not wrong a Muslim nor hand him over
babs.4: Help your brother, whether he is a wrongdoer or wronged
babs.8: Wrongdoing will be darknesses on the Day of Resurrection
babs.9: Guarding against the supplication of the one wronged
babs.10: One who had a claim of wrong against a man and absolved him
babs.11: If he absolves him of his wrong, there is no going back
babs.12: If he permits or absolves him without stating how much it is
babs.13: The sin of one who wrongfully takes any land
babs.14: If a person permits another something, it is valid
babs.15: The saying of Allah the Exalted: "And he is the most quarrelsome of opponents"
babs.16: The sin of one who disputes for falsehood knowingly
babs.17: When he disputes, he behaves shamelessly
babs.18: Retribution of the wronged when he finds the wrongdoer's property
babs.19: What has come about covered halls
babs.20: A neighbour should not prevent his neighbour from fixing a beam in his wall
babs.21: Pouring out wine in the road
babs.22: Courtyards of houses, sitting in them and sitting by the roads
babs.23: Wells by the roads if no one is harmed by them
babs.25: Upper rooms with and without a view, on roofs and elsewhere
babs.26: One who tied his camel on the pavement or at the door of the mosque
babs.27: Standing and urinating at a people's refuse heap
babs.28: One who removed a branch or something harmful to people from the road and threw it away
babs.29: If they disagree about a public road
babs.31: Breaking the cross and killing the pig
babs.33: One who fights in defence of his property
babs.34: If one breaks another's bowl or something else
babs.35: If one demolishes a wall, let him build one like it
